lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct, high-contrast white vertical lines traversing the lateral torso; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in inter-line distance on the mid-posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 10th and 11th lines from the anterior boundary show significant fragmentation and terminate in the mid-torso region; the 1st line near the shoulder terminates before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, concentrated in the superior-posterior quadrant of the hindlimb mass.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch align horizontally, forming a short geometric segment parallel to the dorsal line.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a white chevron-like marking on the bridge of the muzzle and white high-contrast markings on the lower distal limbs (stockings) above the hooves.
